children: may retest a resistance at $91.68 per barrel, a break above could open the way toward $92.76.
The sudden bounce from $88.10 indicates the formation of a temporary bottom. The bullish divergence on the hourly MACD suggests an extension of the bounce.
Three waves or more make up the bounce. The current wave c is expected to travel to its 100% projection level of $91.68. However, this wave is capable of extending far above this level.

Support is at $90.26, a break below may trigger a fall into the $88.85-$89.52 range. On the daily chart, a bullish piercing pattern formed between Monday and Tuesday, strongly signalling a reversal of the downtrend.

A retracement analysis on the uptrend from $69.79 to $118.07 reveals a key support at $88.23, the 61.8% level, which is responsible for the bounce. The support makes the piercing pattern more reliable.
